entries.source:
Current exoskeleton life: %d/%d
		You craft a set of steam powered armor that fits over your regular armor, enhancing your defense. The armor has %d life, and 50%% of all damage taken is redirected to it.
		Your powered armour repairs 5%% of it’s maximum life each turn, and each time you spend steam it will be repaired for %d%% of the steam cost.
		The armor's maximum life will increase with your Steampower.
entries.target:
当前机械外骨骼生命值： %d / %d
		你制造一台蒸汽驱动的机械外骨骼，可以装载在你平常的护甲外面，增强你的防御能力。机械外骨骼具有 %d 生命值，你受到的所有伤害的 50%% 会转移到它身上。
		你的机械外骨骼每回合会修复 5%% 的最大生命值，每当你消耗蒸汽的时候，它也会修复相当于蒸汽消耗量 %d%% 的生命值。
		外骨骼的最大生命值受蒸汽强度加成。

entries.source: %d%% of all incoming damage is redirected to the adjacent Guardian Turret.
entries.target: 所受全部伤害的 %d%% 会转移到邻近的守卫炮台上。

entries.source: Deals %0.2f occult damage per turn and each time a talent is used, the caster regens one turn of a random cooldown.
entries.target: 每回合造成 %0.2f 玄机伤害；目标每次使用技能时，施加者一个随机冷却中技能的冷却时间减少 1 回合。

entries.source: All resistances increased by %d%%, randomly attacks two foes each turn at random.
entries.target: 全部抗性提高 %d%%，每回合随机攻击两个敌人。

entries.source:
On its last pulse, your Tremor Engine shakes violently, raising a volcano for %d turns.
		Each turn, the volcano will send out fiery boulders that deal %0.2f fire and %0.2f physical damage.
		Damage scales with your Steampower.
		#{italic}#All the fury of fire at your disposal!#{normal}#
entries.target:
巨震引擎在最后一次脉冲时剧烈震动，升起一座火山，持续 %d 回合。
		每回合，火山会喷出熔岩球，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害和 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		伤害受蒸汽强度加成。
		#{italic}#品尝火焰之怒吧！#{normal}#

entries.source: Put five points into each of the tinker-crafting talents as any mage class.
entries.target: 以任意法师职业，在每个蒸汽配件制造技能上各投入5点技能点。

entries.source: This hat was made from materials from a forest whose name is long since lost, far in the east. It is said to have belonged to one of the first gunslingers.
entries.target: 这顶皮帽的材料来自遥远东方的一片树林，那片树林的名字早已失传。据说它的主人曾是最早的枪手之一。

entries.source: All steamtech criticals reduce the remaining cooldown of a random steamtech talent by 1.
entries.target: 每次蒸汽科技暴击都会使一个随机蒸汽科技技能的剩余冷却时间减少 1 回合。

entries.source:
Shatters the mind of your victim, giving you full control over its actions for 6 turns.
		When the effect ends, you pull out your mind and the victim's body collapses, dead.
		This effect does not work on rares, bosses, or undead.
		.
entries.target:
粉碎受害者的心智，使你完全控制其行动 6 回合。
　　当效果结束时，你抽离自己的思维，受害者的身体随之倒地死亡。
　　稀有怪、boss、亡灵不受控制。

entries.source: Attackers dealing damage will be healed for %d%% of the damage done.
entries.target: 攻击者造成伤害时，会回复相当于伤害值 %d%% 的生命。

entries.source:
You fire a special antimagic shot with your steamgun(s) at a target for 100%% normal weapon damage.
		The shot will release antimagic sap on the target, doing %0.2f arcane resource burn damage.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.
		Sap damage scales with Steampower.
entries.target:
你使用蒸汽枪向目标发射一枚特殊反魔弹，造成 100%% 普通武器伤害。
		反魔弹会在目标身上释放反魔汁液，造成 %0.2f 奥术资源燃烧伤害。
		这个技能不使用弹药，因为它本身就是弹药。
		汁液伤害取决于蒸汽强度。

entries.source: This old troll stands tall and proud in somewhat ornate clothing; it's clear he is an important figure. He holds in his right hand a wicked looking blade, and in his left hand what seems to be an antique handgun.
entries.target: 这只年长的巨魔昂首挺胸，身穿华丽的服装；不用说，他一定是一个重要人物。他右手持一把邪恶长剑，左手拿着一把古色古香的手枪。

entries.source: Creates a circle of radius %d of altered time for %d turns. Any damage your foes take while standing in it will heal the attacker for 200%% of the damage dealt.
entries.target: 创造一片半径 %d 码的时间错乱之地，持续 %d 回合。敌人站在其中时受到的任何伤害，都会为攻击者回复相当于伤害值 200%% 的生命。

entries.source: Increases the steam your arcane dynamo generate per 10 points of mana by 2.
entries.target: 使你的奥术发电机每消耗10点法力值产生的蒸汽量增加2。

entries.source: The skin of this creature is literally crawling with larvae, yet she seems to be moving toward you very fast.
entries.target: 这个生物的皮肤上确确实实爬满了幼虫，但她似乎正飞快地向你逼近。
